attempted_axis: EXTERN-RETYPE TU pass over src/game/game/player.c: gPlayers was ALREADY typed (`extern Player gPlayers[]`) by the prior de-fakematch pass, so the remaining retype target was `extern u8* gCurLevel` -> `extern level_data*`; then a full offset-by-offset audit of every remaining Player-based raw site against include/game/player.h, converting the ones that resolve to a named field start or a named array element and classifying the rest.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web: APPLIED as the ONLY conversion form used in this TU -- deliberately chosen over member access because player.c is the most matching-delicate of the three TUs (13 live parked/capped attempt records: do_players, PlayerProcessPowerups, create_player_blits, PlayerLoadSaveFile, do_heal_players, check_player_atts, clear_player, ExpToLevel, inactivate_player, init_players, kill_player, player_store_in_save, set_hidden_player, mini_inventory_draw_label). All 25 renames (8 level_data + 17 Player) gated byte-identical in two batches. claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier: SCREENED and honored -- the batches were gated with fndiff real per function and would have been bisected had real moved at all; it did not. claim.law.noop-cast-on-array-decay-not-neutral (discovered this session): APPLIED as a screen and found INAPPLICABLE here for a useful reason -- player.c routes every gCurLevel access through its own `PF(p, off, T)` macro, which already contains the `(u8*)` cast, so the retype required ZERO neutralizing site edits and could not trip the hazard. claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade: SCREENED and DECISIVE for what was NOT done -- include/game/player.h is owned by worker P1 this wave and was not edited, which is also why the large pad-run cluster below stays raw. claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing and claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast: SCREENED, respected -- no typed alias or intermediate pointer was introduced anywhere; every conversion kept the original raw base pointer and changed only the displacement's SPELLING. claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention / claim.law.scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form: SCREENED, no load-update or adjacent read-write-same-address pair touched. claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction: SCREENED, PREC_STRIDE left as a bare 0x335C literal.
attributes.residual: The audit is the durable result here: a classifier run over every `PF(<player-base>, <literal>, T)` site in the TU against player.h's field map returned only 9 distinct offsets (11 sites) landing on a named field start, plus 6 sites resolving to a named array element -- ALL 17 were converted. Every other Player site in this TU is blocked on a MISSING FIELD, not on codegen risk, and the pass is therefore essentially complete for its lane. The blocked set, by pad run, for whoever extends Player next: pad_0870 (9 sites: 0x870/874/878/87C/880/884/888/88C/890 -- a 9-float block, almost certainly three vec3s), pad_08DC (15 sites: 0x8DC/8E0/8E4, read 5x each, a vec3), pad_0924 (8 sites at 0x924, an f32), pad_01EB (5 sites at 0x1EC, s32), pad_095A (4 at 0x95A, s16), pad_0960 (3 at 0x960, s16), pad_0898 (3 at 0x898, f32), pad_0A48 (4: 0xA48/A4C/A50/A54, f32 block), pad_06D8 (4: 0x6D8/6DC), pad_0800 (2: 0x800/804), pad_07A4 (2 at 0x7DC), pad_08B8 (2 at 0x8B8), pad_08D0 (2 at 0x8D0), pad_0078 (2 at 0x78), pad_0A88 (2 at 0xA88), pad_08F4 (2: 0x8F4/8F8), pad_093C (2: 0x93C/940), pad_0A22 (2: 0xA24/A28), plus singletons at 0xC8, 0x744, 0x908, 0x952, 0x956, 0xA8A/A8B/A8E. NOTE ON THE DEBT CENSUS: `gdlmem.py debt` still reports player.c at 223 bare / 174 pf / 10 named, numerically UNCHANGED by this pass, because its regex counts any `PF(...)` occurrence as a pf_site whether the offset is a bare literal or an offsetof expression. The 17 conversions are real (grep shows offsetof uses in player.c went 18 -> 35); the census simply cannot see inside a project-local accessor macro. Do not read player.c's flat debt number as 'no work done' -- and consider teaching the census to distinguish PF-with-literal from PF-with-offsetof.
